mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_feedback_handoff_task WHERE provider_idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_handoff_task SET delivery_status='FAILED',delivery_failure_reason=#{reason}, delivery_confirmed_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_feedback_handoff_task SET compensation_status='PENDING' WHERE distribution_batch_id=#{batchId} AND task_status='DELIVERED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_feedback_handoff_task WHERE distribution_batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_handoff_task SET task_status='ROLLED_BACK', compensation_status='COMPLETED',compensated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_feedback_handoff_task SET compensation_status='FAILED' WHERE distribution_batch_id=#{batchId} AND compensation_status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT provider_idempotency_key FROM t_feedback_handoff_task WHERE delivery_status='UNKNOWN' AND compensation_status='NOT_REQUIRED' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
